purpose: Deterministic sampled demand family fixture generated from the committed demand artifact fixture and paired sampled weather family fixture.

provenance.author: OpenAI Codex
provenance.origin: Synthetic current-library US2 family-result fixture for offline paired replay coverage.
provenance.generation_command: Replay the committed offline demand sampler against tests/fixtures/demand/fitted_demand_artifact_v1.json and tests/fixtures/weather/sampled_weather_family_case.json with paired_family_seed 13.
provenance.refresh_policy: Update only when the stable offline demand sampling contract, weather-driver requirements, or deterministic paired-seed derivation intentionally change.

notes: Generated against the committed weather family fixture with the same shared paired-family seed so scenario ordering and replay semantics remain exact across both producers.
Keeps the committed result small by reusing the three-step, two-scenario daily fixture pair while still exercising explicit non-thermal electric and cooling outputs.
